summary: Use a <table> for data in rows and columns, like a gradebook. Each <tr> is a row, <th> is a header cell, and <td> is a data cell.
notes: <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot> group the header rows, data rows, and summary row.
scope="col" and scope="row" tell screen readers which header goes with each cell, so a score is read as "Byte Club, Code, 45".
<caption> must be the first thing inside <table>.
pitfall: Using a table to place things side by side on a page. Tables are for data; use flexbox or grid for layout.
